title: The World Magnetic Model 2025 (WMM2025): Gauss coefficients of the Earth's main magnetic field and its secular variation to degree 12, with NOAA's test values and the technical report
provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI) and the British Geological Survey (BGS), for the US National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) and the UK Defence Geographic Centre (DGC)
credit: Geomagnetic field: WMM2025 (NOAA NCEI and BGS)
format: WMM.COF: NOAA's coefficient format, ASCII. A header line (epoch 2025.0 as a decimal year, the model's name WMM-2025, its release date 11/13/2024), then one row per degree n and order m to n = m = 12: n, m, g and h (nT), and their secular variation g-dot and h-dot (nT per year); h is 0 for m = 0; two lines of 9s end the file. Schmidt semi-normalised Gauss coefficients of the internal potential on the reference sphere a = 6 371 200 m, in geocentric spherical coordinates. WMM2025_TestValues.txt: 100 points (decimal year, height above the WGS 84 ellipsoid in km, geodetic latitude and longitude in degrees) with D and I (degrees, 2 decimals), H, X, Y, Z, F (nT, 6 decimals) and their rates (per year, 6 decimals). WMM2025_TEST_VALUES.txt: the 12 points of the report's Table 6 with the grid variation, to 0.1 nT and 0.01 degree. WMM_Report_2025.pdf: the technical report, whose section 1.2 states the model's equations and whose Tables 3a and 3b give a high-precision numerical example; domains/geophysics/tests/make_wmm_fixtures.py takes its values from it. Members of WMM2025COF.zip are read by range requests.
coverage: Global; from 2025.0 to 2030.0 (to be used from 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2029); specified from 1 km below the WGS 84 ellipsoid to 850 km above it (report section 1.1, after MIL-PRF-89500B)
